comment: Great professor who cracked lots of jokes, brought in cupcakes for us one day, discussions were fun and the textbook was interesting.

Loved Tate for FYS - it was truly my least demanding class. very easy class to sit through. essay topics were fairly easy to write about, as long as you put the effort in, you won't get a bad grade. also has a great sense of humor. 110% recommend/would take her again if possible
Awesome lady. Very funny. Clearly very knowledgeable about the course (FYS: Wrongful Convictions). Highly recommend.

She is so sweet! Wrongful Convictions was extremely easy and having a nice/fun teacher made it a million times better. Just skim the readings (or read the intros) and say a few things in class and she will love you. Only grades were participation and a few essays. She is a nice grader and gives good feedback. I adore her! Take this class!

One of my favorite teachers at Richmond so far and her wrongful convictions class has also been my favorite class. It was interesting and easy. She assigns a lot of readings, but you can get away with skimming most of it and she grades papers very leniently.  She cares about her students and even invited us to her house for crepes. She's great!

Professor Tate is amazing. Class was super relaxed and calm, and she kept things interesting. I was genuinely excited to come to class because the material was interesting and the discussions were engaging. She really knows what she's talking about, and I learned a lot even though it was a relatively easy class

Professor Tate is awesome! She truly wants the best for her students and is willing to help anyone who wants it. Her class isn't easy, but you can definitely be successful if you put forth the effort and meet with her about your papers. Professor Tate is hilarious and easily one of the best teachers I've had at UR! Take her class if you can!

Prof Tate is easily one of the best teachers I have ever had. She's understanding, clear, hilarious, awesome. I've learned so much this semester about life, the law, and anything else that was on our minds. Dr. Tate is a MUST TAKE if you have the chance. She expects you to work hard, but rewards you for effort and involvement. She's AWESOME.
